subject: corpus: compositor gate RERUN ad62ed9e/9ff66cac + QG4 warmup table found
body:
gpu/build/ui-corpus-20261025/compositor-gate-20261025/rerun-ad62ed9e/{README.md,summary.json}. Host-only, workers=1, 735 pairs x ~10 shapes, default flags and +THREAD_STORAGE16; render_pipeline.inc sha cf6a51b22d9e. Cross-check vs lowering's private after-ad62ed9e: 2389 common keys, 0 differences; vs 742cdf3d: 110 fixed, 0 regressed.
DEFAULT BUILD still nil: (1) asg_frag_lph (graphics TLS; builds with flag16 but render never passes THREAD_STORAGE); (2) inplace_copy_{lpf,lph} (interlock refusal); (3) 14 RT2-only path_* IF the BGRA slots have ACTIVE masks (render compiles each active rt; shader writes only rt2 -> 'not written'); built with [absent,absent,R8:15]; path_blit builds either way; (4) 18 std_vert0 pairs whose fragment consumes both varyings still 'Vertex varying layout does not cover' (std_vert1 builds them; cover fix built the other 120 combos incl path_stroke_curve); (5) every warmup spec with pixel format outside {10,70,80,115}; (6) 1079 fixed-UI specs unverified (6 captured serials ok). 90/93 non-fixed fragments and 39/39 vertex functions now have building partners (was 72/95). Kernels: compute_apl x3 compile, tile_downsample refused.
INERT: TEGU_INERT_PIPELINES is a compile-time #ifdef (render_pipeline.inc:1864/1881), no per-process gate -> 'backboardd only' needs a separate build or runtime check. With it, items 1-6 become non-nil inert (draws refused, nothing drawn); still nil: RENDER_REQUIRE failures before diagnosticOwned, missing COMPOSITOR/GENERIC_JOB caps, alloc failure.
VERDICT: still YES (nil PSO -> abort) with default build, narrower; with inert flag no known abort but several pipelines draw nothing. Hardware unproven.
QG4 (local iOS 16.7 dyld cache, private): QuartzCore WarmupShaders iterates a 1079-entry static fixed-UI spec table (VM 0x1d5b3b350; strings like P0081Xm_A2Xghfc), each gated by [device supportsFeatureSet:{4,11,16,17}] (require/exclude), compiled over the context's 6 MTLPixelFormats. CA format codes: b3a8 301, w40a 262, BGRA 256, w30r 225, RGhA 13, L555 6, L008 4, 0551/0553 3, 0081/LA88/RGBA 2. 258..839 specs warmed depending on supportsFeatureSet (Tegu does not implement it). Named blur/path/shading shaders are created on demand. NOT decoded: spec->function-constants (parser 0x1884868c0), the 6 formats, CA code->MTLPixelFormat. Asks: audit/corpus decode spec->fc (turns QG5 into a bounded <=839 list); render: pass THREAD_STORAGE and decide runtime inert switch.
